name: justify-multiline
note: text-align:justify on a multi-line paragraph: every non-last line stretches its inter-word spaces so the line fills the block's content width; the final line stays left-aligned. Line-fragment x/width match Chrome's stretched lines within the rect tolerance.

harvest.html: justify this paragraph of text across multiple lines so that it wraps and the inter word spacing stretches to fill the full available width of the box each line
